Label: Purpose
ID: To identify the withdrawn record so that harvesters can delete it from their indexes.

Label: Entry Guidelines
ID: Enter the record's identifier exactly as it appeared in the record: the value of [ID](../ogm-aardvark/#id) (`id`) for OGM Aardvark records, or `layer_slug_s` for GBL 1.0 records. Do not add leading or trailing spaces.

Label: Commentary
ID: This is the value a harvester deletes from Solr, so it must match character for character. It is not a druid, ARK, file path, or the value of [Identifier](../ogm-aardvark/#identifier). If your repository published the same item under different identifiers in more than one schema (for example, in both `metadata-1.0/` and `metadata-aardvark/`), add an entry for each.
